captions.detailed: A compact laboratory monocular microscope featuring a heavy rectangular base, a vertical support column, and a curved rear arm. It includes a dark rectangular specimen stage with metal slide clips, a rotating objective turret with multiple lenses, and an angled monocular eyepiece tube. Two independent, side-mounted focus knobs (coarse and fine) are located on the arm, finished in black and grey plastic to match the overall scientific equipment styling.
captions.instruction: Generate a compact laboratory monocular microscope with a heavy base, a vertical support column, a dark rectangular specimen stage with slide clips, and an angled monocular eyepiece. The optical assembly should slide vertically, the objective turret should rotate, and independent coarse and fine focus knobs should be modeled on the side of the arm.
captions.factory: Construct the base and vertical column using box primitives. Create the specimen stage as a thin dark box, adding small rectangular clips. Model the optical tube using cylinder primitives rotated to an angle, and attach a rotating objective turret with small cylindrical nosepieces. Define prismatic joints for the vertical motion of the optical body carriage and the horizontal motion of the stage, and add continuous rotational joints for the objective turret and the independent focus knobs.
